description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeTerminationAPI class, which manages CRUD operations for employee termination records within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It provides endpoints for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting employee termination records via RESTful API calls, employing validation rules, Swagger annotations for documentation, and integrating with the core Employee and EmployeeTermination entities and services.

classes.name: EmployeeTerminationAPI
classes.description: Defines REST API endpoints for managing employee termination records, including get, create, update, and delete operations. Implements validation, Swagger documentation annotations, and integrates with underlying Employee and EmployeeTerminationRecord entities.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific employee termination record based on employee number and record ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new employee termination record linked to a specific employee.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing employee termination record identified by record ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the employee termination record associated with a specified employee.
